title: Concept record (BRIEF §2)
description: One schema-validated record per row of BRIEF §2's concept-ownership table. Records are the test manifest: the conformance suite is parameterised over them at collection time. CONCEPTS.md is a generated projection and is never hand-edited.

id.description: Kebab-case concept id; also names concepts/snapshots/<id>/ and conformance/vectors/<id>/.

posture.description: Tannen's posture per the BRIEF §2 table row.

grade.description: BRIEF §2.1. S-pending: data-shaped but the owner has not yet published vectors; the prose pin stands in (CLAUDE.md: never write vectors on the owner's behalf).

brief_row.description: Verbatim-enough citation of the BRIEF §2 table row this record executes.

brief_row_divergence.description: Declared, deliberate narrowing of this record against the BRIEF §2 row it quotes (D0180): owners that row names which this record does not cite. scripts/check_concepts.py's second tooth reads it — an undeclared divergence fails, and a declaration naming an owner the row does not name (or one the record cites anyway) fails as stale.

decision.description: The record that rules the divergence.

repo.description: Canonical repo identity (URL, or 'this repo (tannen)' for owned concepts).

document.description: Path of the cited document within the owner repo.

section.description: The cited section(s), as cited by BRIEF §2.

commit.description: Pinned commit SHA of the owner repo. Null only when the owner repo has no commit to pin (e.g. tannen itself pre-brief-freeze); then commit_note is required.

lines.description: Line range(s) of the cited section within the pinned document, or 'whole file'.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the vendored snapshot.

sha256.description: sha256 of the snapshot file bytes.

vectors.description: Grade S only: repo-relative path of the vendored frozen vector corpus. A grade-S record naming a missing corpus fails pytest collection (BRIEF §2).

pending_reason.description: Grade S-pending only: why no vectors yet.

tests.description: Law/property/conformance test paths or pytest node ids enforcing this concept. May be empty pre-M0.

review_marker.description: Grade P: how the concept gates PRs through review, citing the owner.
